ask._.vee: Yann Vee stepped off the supply cart at S-F10 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Yann Vee received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
Yann Vee left the work of a rifleman to become a sapper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.
Now serving as a sniper, Yann Vee discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
Yann Vee (Concord) and Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) met in the same shell hole at Calvary Farm during a raid. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
At Calvary Farm, Teodor Acakostic of the Hegemony and Yann Vee of the Concord traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.

A shouted challenge from Yann Vee (Concord) reached Gustav "Tin" Jul (Hegemony) at the Drowned Farm. The answer was lost beneath the guns. The challenge was not repeated. The Concord took Verdel Ridge, and the orders at S-F10 changed before the cheering ended. Yann Vee shouldered another load.
Dawn watch. Yann Vee put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Edmund Matteozrybak, badly wounded.

Yann Vee tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. A letter from home found Yann Vee before the night shift. Yann Vee folded it small and kept it close.
